seriesTitle: Junji Ito Maniac: Japanese Tales of the Macabre

episodes.title: "The Strange Hikizuri Siblings"
episodes.summary: A photographer with an interest in spirits and ghosts pays a visit to the very strange and creepy home where the six Hikizuri siblings live.

episodes.title: "The Story of the Mysterious Tunnel" "Ice Cream Bus"
episodes.summary: Goro returns to the tunnel he saw his mother once walk into. An ice cream truck arrives in the neighborhood, driven by a bewitching young man.

episodes.title: "Hanging Balloon"
episodes.summary: After a popular idol dies by what appears to be suicide, there are multiple sightings of her giant, grotesque head floating in the sky.

episodes.title: "Four x Four Walls" "The Sandman’s Lair"
episodes.summary: Koichi can't study because his younger brother Soichi is constantly making noise. Tormented by his dreams, Yuji asks his friend Mari to keep him awake.

episodes.title: "Intruder" "Long Hair in the Attic"
episodes.summary: Oshikiri has been hearing strange footsteps in the house he lives in alone. Chiemi wakes up to find a rat stuck in her long, black hair.

episodes.title: "Mold" "Library Vision"
episodes.summary: A year after renting his house to Mr. Rogi, Akasaka finds mold growing everywhere. Koko's husband Goro is obsessed with maintaining his library.

episodes.title: "Tomb Town"
episodes.summary: After hitting a girl with his car, Tsuyoshi and his sister Kaoru find that the road they're driving on is blocked by countless tombstones.

episodes.title: "Layers of Terror" "The Thing that Drifted Ashore"
episodes.summary: When an accident causes her to lose half her face, Reimi discovers that her younger selves still exist inside her. An eerie sea creature drifts ashore.

episodes.title: "Tomie・Photo"
episodes.summary: A menacing transfer student named Tomie isn't happy that a girl named Tsukiko has been taking and selling pictures of popular boys in their school.

episodes.title: "Unendurable Labyrinth" "The Bully"
episodes.summary: Two friends get lost in the mountains and come across a community of ascetic monks. Kuriko ends up bullying a younger boy she's been playing with.

episodes.title: "Alley" "Headless Statue"
episodes.summary: A young man moves into a boarding house next to an enclosed alley. An art teacher known for his headless sculptures is found murdered — with no head.

episodes.title: "Whispering Woman" "Soichi's Beloved Pet"
episodes.summary: A mysterious woman calmly takes on the job of helping a hysterical girl unable to make any decisions on her own. Soichi's family adopts a pet cat.
